mapper.sql: SELECT id, employee_id, work_type_id, price, effective_at, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag FROM smt_price_rule
mapper.select: SELECT price FROM smt_price_rule WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND work_type_id = #{workTypeId} AND del_flag = '0' AND effective_at <= NOW() ORDER BY effective_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.employee_id, p.work_type_id, p.price, p.effective_at, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.del_flag, e.name AS employee_name, w.name AS work_type_name FROM smt_price_rule p LEFT JOIN smt_employee e ON e.id = p.employee_id AND e.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN smt_work_type w ON w.id = p.work_type_id AND w.del_flag = '0' WHERE p.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY p.employee_id ASC, p.work_type_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO smt_price_rule ( employee_id, work_type_id, price, effective_at, create_by, create_time, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{workTypeId}, #{price}, IFNULL(#{effectiveAt}, NOW()), #{createBy}, NOW(), '0' )

INSERT INTO smt_price_rule ( employee_id, work_type_id, price, effective_at, create_by, create_time, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{workTypeId}, #{price}, IFNULL(#{effectiveAt}, NOW()), #{createBy}, NOW(), '0' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE price = VALUES(price), effective_at = VALUES(effective_at), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), del_flag = '0'
mapper.update:
UPDATE smt_price_rule
employee_id = #{employeeId},
work_type_id = #{workTypeId},
price = #{price},
effective_at = #{effectiveAt},
update_by = #{updateBy},
update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
UPDATE smt_price_rule SET del_flag = '2', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
